title: A site adds news sources without an engine release
description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-5ca2e3.

`monitoring_feed.FEED_HOSTS` and `monitoring.SOURCE_TYPES` are lists in code. Feed hosts and source kinds become data an administrator can add.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR #1425. Decision: a feed monitor's config may carry sourceName; with it any public https host is accepted (no IPs, localhost, internal names, credentials, odd ports); without it only built-in hosts. Only feeds need no code, so source kinds are not made data: a new reader still needs code in SOURCE_TYPES.
